value.signature: fn select_effective_declaration < 'a > (records : & 'a ValidatedRecords , namespace : & str , name : & str , boundary : u64 ,) -> Result < & 'a Declaration , ValidationError >

review.body: { if let Some (cause) = invalid_key (namespace , name) { refused () ; return Err (ValidationError :: InvalidSelectionKey (cause)) ; } let selected = records . declarations . iter () . filter (| d | d . id . namespace == namespace && d . id . name == name && d . announced_at <= boundary && d . effective_at <= boundary) . max_by_key (| d | d . effective_at) ; selected . ok_or_else (| | { refused () ; ValidationError :: MissingDeclaration { namespace : namespace . into () , name : name . into () , boundary , } }) }
review.item_premise: Rejects malformed keys and selects a validated opaque edition by its effective boundary. Late announcements refused during validation cannot rewrite historical answers.
